title: Software Engineering Practice in the Virtual Reality/Augmented Reality Software Life Cycle: A Systematic Survey
abstract: arXiv:2611.18567v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Leveraging diverse virtual reality (VR) technologies, VR provides users with an immersive experience in a computer-generated 3D virtual environment. In contrast, augmented reality (AR) superimposes virtual objects (such as images, text, animations, etc.) onto users' real scenes. Both VR and AR have received increasing attention due to the maturity of computer graphics, computer vision, and artificial intelligence. VR and AR have gained rapid market growth in both hardware and software. translated_title: 虚拟现实/增强现实软件生命周期中的软件工程实践：一项系统性综述
translated_abstract: 虚拟现实（VR）利用多种虚拟现实技术，为用户提供计算机生成的三维虚拟环境中的沉浸式体验；相比之下，增强现实（AR）则将虚拟物体（如图像、文本、动画等）叠加到用户的真实场景中。得益于计算机图形学、计算机视觉和人工智能技术的成熟，VR和AR受到越来越多的关注，并在硬件和软件方面均实现了快速的市场增长。在早期阶段，VR/AR相关研究主要集中于硬件（例如头戴式显示器和配备传感器的控制器）。近年来，随着VR/AR生态系统的成熟，VR/AR软件已成为热门研究话题。然而，目前尚缺乏对VR/AR软件工程实践的系统性总结工作。为填补这一空白，本文旨在从软件（工程）的视角，对VR/AR领域的最新研究现状进行系统性综述。
tldr: 该论文首次从软件工程视角对VR/AR软件生命周期相关研究进行系统性综述，填补了该领域缺乏全面总结的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic survey of software engineering practices across the VR/AR software life cycle, filling the gap of comprehensive coverage in this emerging field.
